title: OSM ODbL share-alike output kit (derived-DB vs produced-work, attribution)
context: Any explainer derived from OpenStreetMap data must carry the ODbL 1.0 share-alike license on derived databases and the mandatory '© OpenStreetMap contributors' attribution string. The distinction between a derived database (ODbL) and a produced work (map/visual, CC-BY-SA) is critical and easily mishandled. A reusable kit that enforces this prevents share-alike violations across all OSM-derived modules (amenities-017 and any future OSM task).
objective: Build a reusable OSM ODbL share-alike output kit: code and templates that correctly handle the derived-database vs. produced-work distinction, embed the required attribution, and propagate share-alike — never relicensing an ODbL derivative as permissive.
acceptanceCriteria: Kit codifies the ODbL derived-database vs. produced-work distinction: derived databases output as ODbL-1.0; produced maps and visuals output as CC-BY-SA; toolkit code as MIT.
Required '© OpenStreetMap contributors' attribution string is automatically embedded in all OSM-derived output.
Share-alike propagation is enforced: no ODbL-derived database is relicensed as permissive.
Code is MIT-licensed; pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint pass; commit is DCO signed-off.
License reviewer verifies the kit's attribution and share-alike handling before merge.
output: An ODbL share-alike output kit (code + templates + license handling logic) committed to the project repo as a PR, ready for reuse by amenities-017 and any future OSM-derived task.
